basic_profile.bio: I'm a 20-year-old Latino guy living in Texas. I'm currently studying automotive engineering at a local college and work part-time at an auto repair shop. I love working on cars and listening to true crime podcasts during my free time. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after classes and work. I enjoy discussing new tech in blockchain and watching TV dramas.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a good mix of formal education in automotive engineering and self-taught skills in cryptocurrency and investment, primarily through online resources and forums.
